Images.description: Images to be displayed on the alert and/or corresponding incident.

items.description: An image to be displayed on the incident or alert.

alt.description: Optional alternative text for the image.

src.description: The source of the image being attached to the incident or alert. This image must be served via HTTPS.

Links.description: Links to be shown on the alert and/or corresponding incident.

items.description: A link to be attached to an incident or alert.

href.description: The link being attached to an incident or alert.

text.description: Optional information pertaining to this context link.

Payload.description: Fields adding additional context about the location, impact, and character of the PagerDuty event.

component.description: Component of the source machine that is responsible for the event.

custom_details.description: Additional details about the event and affected system.

group.description: Logical grouping of components of a service.

severity.description: The perceived severity of the status the event is describing withrespect to the affected system.

source.description: The unique location of the affected system, preferably a hostname or FQDN.

summary.description: A brief text summary of the event, used to generate the summaries/titles of any associated alerts.

timestamp.description: The time at which the emitting tool detected or generated the event.

post.description: Your monitoring tools should send PagerDuty a trigger event to report a new problem, or update an ongoing problem, depending on the event type.

images.alt: An example link with an image

client.description: The name of the monitoring client that is triggering this event. (This field is only used for `trigger` events.)

client_url.description: The URL of the monitoring client that is triggering this event. (This field is only used for `trigger` events.)

dedup_key.description: Identifies the alert to `trigger`, `acknowledge`, or `resolve`. Required unless the `event_type` is `trigger`.

event_action.description: The type of event. Can be `trigger`, `acknowledge` or `resolve`.

routing_key.description: The GUID of one of your Events API V2 integrations. This is the "Integration Key" listed on the Events API V2 integration's detail page.
